    deal)? 1 = yes; 0 = no / none documented; uncertain.

    interface (operations vs people/management/culture; integration of operations
    broke against the organization over time)? 1 = yes; 0 = no / none documented;
    uncertain.

    one-sided dominance)? A channel SEPARATE from the product/process and
    process/organization pathways. 1 = yes; 0 = no; uncertain.

    (value-capture logics that could not be reconciled over time)? A channel
    SEPARATE from the pathways above. 1 = yes; 0 = no; uncertain.

# Outcome sub-dossier — South State Corporation realized record after the Park Sterling merger, ~3-5-year horizon (~2020-2022)

> EVIDENTIARY STANDARD: every factual line ends with a `[SRC: <SEC accession / URL>]`
> tag pointing to a public primary source. A fact that cannot be so sourced is written
> `[UNVERIFIED]` and is never guessed. South State Corporation remained a continuing
> SEC-reporting company after the transaction, so its own subsequent Form 10-K is the
> traceable outcome record; this sub-dossier draws only on that later filing and
> contains no information about how the transaction was structured at closing.

## Public-reporting status after the transaction (feasibility-relevant)
- South State Corporation (CIK 0000764038) continued filing annual reports on Form
  10-K after the merger, including a Form 10-K for fiscal year 2020 filed February 26,
  2021 — approximately three years after the November 30, 2017 closing. [SRC: SEC accession 0001558370-21-001976, Form 10-K FY2020]
- The FY2020 10-K's financial statements and notes present South State's business on a
  consolidated basis; no section of the reviewed filing separately breaks out the
  post-acquisition performance of the specific Park Sterling business or branch network
  as a standalone segment. [SRC: SEC accession 0001558370-21-001976, Form 10-K FY2020]

## A subsequent, separately reported combination within the window
- On June 7, 2020, South State (the "Company") acquired all outstanding common stock of
  CenterState Bank Corporation ("CSFL") in a stock-for-stock transaction: CSFL merged
  with and into the Company, with the Company continuing as the surviving corporation,
  and immediately thereafter South State Bank ("SSB") merged with and into CenterState
  Bank ("CSB"), with CSB continuing as the surviving bank and changing its name to South
  State Bank, National Association; CSFL shareholders received 0.3001 shares of the
  Company's common stock per CSFL share. [SRC: SEC accession 0001558370-21-001976, Form 10-K FY2020]
- Following this second combination, the Company's total assets increased 137.4% and
  shareholders' equity increased 95.9% during 2020, and full-time-equivalent employees
  grew to 5,184 as of December 31, 2020 (compared with 2,547 a year earlier); the
  Company reported 285 full-service branches as of December 31, 2020, concentrated in
  Florida (36%), South Carolina (34%), Georgia (17%), North Carolina (6%), Alabama (6%)
  and Virginia (1%). [SRC: SEC accession 0001558370-21-001976, Form 10-K FY2020]
- Because this later combination occurred within the outcome window and was reported
  on a fully consolidated basis together with all prior acquisitions (including Park
  Sterling), the reviewed filing does not permit isolation of a Park-Sterling-specific
  post-close trajectory distinct from the Company's overall consolidated results.
  [UNVERIFIED]

## Realized financial scalar (consolidated, FY2020)
- Net income available to common shareholders decreased 35.3% to $120.6 million in
  2020, compared with $186.5 million in 2019 (itself down from $178.9 million in 2018);
  diluted/basic earnings per common share fell to $2.20 in 2020 from $5.40 in 2019.
  [SRC: SEC accession 0001558370-21-001976, Form 10-K FY2020]
- The filing attributes the 2020 net-income decline mainly to an increase in the
  provision for credit losses (including day-one CECL-related provisions recorded upon
  the 2020 combination) and to expenses related to that combination, alongside effects
  of the COVID-19 pandemic on credit conditions. [SRC: SEC accession 0001558370-21-001976, Form 10-K FY2020]
- Goodwill grew from $1,002.9 million at the start of 2020 to $1,563.9 million at
  year-end 2020, an addition of $561.0 million attributed to the 2020 combination; the
  Company's own goodwill-impairment testing (as of its April 30, 2020 annual test date
  and again as of December 31, 2020) concluded no impairment charge was necessary,
  notwithstanding that the Company's stock price traded below book value for much of
  2020 amid the pandemic. [SRC: SEC accession 0001558370-21-001976, Form 10-K FY2020]

## Items sought but not found
- No section of the reviewed FY2020 10-K separately reports branch closures,
  consolidations, or systems-conversion completion specifically tied to the Park
  Sterling branch network (as distinct from branch-network changes attributable to the
  later 2020 combination). [UNVERIFIED]
- No goodwill-impairment, divestiture, or write-down specifically attributed to the
  Park Sterling acquisition was located in the reviewed filing. [UNVERIFIED]

## Outcome summary (realized record only)
- South State Corporation remained the continuing public registrant through the
  outcome window and filed audited annual reports throughout, so a public outcome
  record exists at the consolidated-company level, but the reviewed FY2020 10-K does
  not separately disclose a Park-Sterling-specific post-close trajectory — that facet is
  coded uncertain (no isolable public record) rather than inferred from consolidated
  results. [SRC: SEC accession 0001558370-21-001976, Form 10-K FY2020]
- At the consolidated-company level, the best-documented realized scalars within the
  window are a 35.3% year-over-year decline in net income available to common
  shareholders in 2020 (to $120.6 million) attributed substantially to credit-loss
  provisions and expenses tied to a subsequent, much larger combination (with CSFL/
  CenterState, closed June 7, 2020) rather than to the Park Sterling transaction itself,
  alongside a goodwill balance that grew but was not found impaired as of year-end 2020.
  [SRC: SEC accession 0001558370-21-001976, Form 10-K FY2020]

[SLICE END]
